title: 第017章 兵种刷新招募卡第018章 稳定才是一切
slug: 领主神级词条招募原罪堕天使
lines: 随着时间的流逝。
夜幕降临，苏业才醒过来，看着燃烧的篝火。
苏业伸了一个懒腰：“辛苦了，塔丽丝。”
“帝皇陛下这是我该做的。”塔丽丝脸上没有任何波动的说道，还是那副三无的神情。
苏业没有再说什么，塔丽丝的性格就是这样，打开了聊天频道，看了看私聊。
大部分都是片哥片姐的私聊，特么的这些信息是最多的，直接拉黑删除一条龙，看了一下私聊没什么信息，打开了好友聊天面板。
苏业现在就一个好友，那就是小小商人。
“又发消息了，什么消息？找到科技之种了嘛？”苏业有些好奇的看了一下。
“嗯？”苏业眼中带着一丝诧异和震惊。
【小小商人：大佬对兵种刷新招募卡感兴趣嘛？】
【小小商人：不在吗？感兴趣可以私聊一下。】
“兵种刷新招募卡?”苏业深吸一口气，这玩意现在就有人开出来了吗？
不过这一届的新手领主有数十亿人，这么大的基数开出来这种东西也不是什么奇怪的事情。
兵种刷新招募卡这东西怎么说呢？对于某些领主来说，这东西还不如一张资源卡有用，但是对于苏业来说那就是神卡。
不要觉得这东西没人卖，同样有人卖，对于一般的领主来说每天的招募名额就足够了，甚至用不了这么多。
不要忘记了，兵种也是需要消耗食物的，普通的领主能够维持每日兵种招募开支就已经是不错的事情了。
甚至大部分领主都无法维持兵种每日开销，这才是正常情况。
所以这张卡对于普通领主来说，还不如一张高级食物资源卡来的实在，他们不缺兵种数量，缺少的是物资，实实在在的物资。
【异界旅人：在吗？这东西多少钱？你有多少？】
苏业直接发了过去。
小小商人这边，看到苏业的消息，直接放弃了和某个领主的私聊。
【小小商人：在在在，在的大佬，兵种刷新招募卡我手里有五张，价格一张：1000金币，大佬你看如何？】
苏业看着小小商人发来的消息，五张兵种刷新招募卡，眼中带着一丝精光，五张，如果刷新堕天圣堂的话。
自己就能多出一百五十单位的堕天兵种。
【异界旅人：可以，你手上有多少兵种刷新招募卡，我就要多少，麻烦你帮我留一下多收购一些。】
林小小看着苏业发来的消息，眼睛都变成了金币的符号。
【小小商人：当然没问题大佬，你要的科技之种正在帮你找，应该要不了多久就能找到了，申请交易了，大佬同意一下。】
【异界旅人：好。】
苏业看着弹出来的申请交易，直接选择了同意。
五张兵种刷新招募卡到手。
content_en:
As time goes by.
As night fell, Su Ye woke up and looked at the burning bonfire.
Su ye stretched out and said, "Thank you for your hard work, Talis."
"Your Majesty, this is what I should do." Talis said without any fluctuation on her face, still with the same look of nothingness.
Su ye didn't say anything else. This was Talis's character. He opened the chat channel and looked at the private chat.
Most of them were private chats between Pian Ge and Pian Sister, and these were the most messages. I blocked and deleted them directly. I looked at the private chats and found no information, so I opened the friend chat panel.
Su ye has only one good friend now, a small businessman.
"Sent another message, what news? Have you found the seed of technology?" Su ye looked at it curiously.
"Huh?" Su ye had a hint of surprise and shock in his eyes.
[Little businessman: Is the boss interested in the military refresh recruitment card? 】
[Little businessman: Aren’t you here? If you are interested, you can chat privately. 】
"Unit refresh recruitment card?" Su ye took a deep breath. Has anyone released this thing now?
However, there are billions of novice lords in this generation, so it is not strange for such a large base to open something like this.
What do you mean by the troop refresh recruitment card? For some lords, this thing is not as useful as a resource card, but for Su ye, it is a god card.
Don't think that no one is selling this thing, there are people who are selling it. For ordinary lords, the daily recruitment quota is enough, and they don't even use that many.
Don't forget that troops also need to consume food. It is good for ordinary lords to be able to maintain their daily military recruitment expenses.
Even most lords cannot maintain the daily expenses of their troops. This is normal.
Therefore, this card is not as practical as a high-level food resource card for ordinary lords. They do not lack the number of troops, but they lack supplies, real supplies.
[Traveler from another world: Are you there? How much does this thing cost? How many do you have? 】
Su ye sent it directly.
On the small business side, after seeing the news about Su Ye, they immediately gave up their private chat with a certain lord.
[Little businessman: Hey, hey, hey, big brother, I have five unit refresh recruitment cards in my hand. The price of each card is 1,000 gold coins. What do you think, big brother? 】
Su Ye looked at the message sent by the small businessman. There were five recruitment cards to refresh the troops, with a glint in his eyes. Five cards, if the Fallen Temple was refreshed.
He would be able to generate an additional 150 units of fallen troops.
[Traveler from another world: Okay, I will take as many of the refreshed recruitment cards for the troops as you have in your hand. Please help me keep them and buy more. 】
Lin Xiaoxiao's eyes turned into gold coin symbols when he looked at the message from Su Ye.
[Small businessman: Of course, no problem, boss. The technology you want is being found for you. It should not take long to find it. I have applied for a transaction. The boss agrees. 】
[Traveler from another world: OK. 】
Su ye looked at the application transaction that popped up and directly chose to agree.
Five arms refresh recruitment cards are obtained.
title_en: Chapter 017 Refreshing Recruitment Cards for Troops Chapter 018 Stability is Everything
